token_pricing.basis: Official API-equivalent USD per 1M tokens; Claude Sonnet 5 and Opus 5 use Anthropic's official current list prices and Claude Code subscription charges are not represented as provider spend; GPT-5.6 Sol uses the current promotional short-context Standard rates; DeepSeek V4 retains its separately declared API price bands; GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash use the official Z.AI standard USD list prices; Coding Plan quota-consumption bands and the Flash 50% API promotion ending 2026-09-09 are intentionally excluded from GLM API-equivalent dollars; Grok 4.6 uses the explicitly named current public Grok 4.5 tariff until xAI publishes a 4.6 price row; Gemini 3.7 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash use Google's current Standard promotional tariff through 2026-12-31 and their output prices already include thinking tokens; HY4 Preview uses Tencent's official public API rates and CodeBuddy subscription charges are not represented as provider spend; GPT-6 Astra uses current Standard API-equivalent short/long-context rates with separately verified cache writes; not Codex subscription payments or Fast/Batch/Flex spend

gpt-6-astra.reference_reason: Official GPT-6 Astra current Standard API-equivalent tariff; request input >272000 uses long-context rates. Requires complete server-derived cache-write counters. https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6-astra; https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/prompt-caching

deepseek-v4.1-flash.reference_reason: Official DeepSeek time-of-use tariff for deepseek-flash, served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: peak is 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC on weekdays (09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 Asia/Shanghai) and off-peak is exactly half of peak; legacy deepseek-v4-flash and vision-exp names are billed at this same Flash price

grok-4.6.reference_reason: The authenticated Grok catalog exposes Grok 4.6 but the public xAI pricing table has not yet added a 4.6 row; use the current official Grok 4.5 500k-context tariff as the explicit API-equivalent reference
